title: Camera fixed and Evia UI restored
details: Photo and video capture now stay inside Evia's normal learner screen instead of opening the detached yellow capture page
The learner still sees Evia, the current task and the bottom progress arches while collecting evidence
The square 1:1 photo shutter now waits for a real camera frame before it can be pressed and captures the image reliably
If the in-app camera cannot capture on a device, Evia offers the phone camera instead of silently doing nothing
Guided video keeps camera and microphone recording, prompt-by-prompt guidance and timestamp markers
Photo evidence still requires a written explanation and video extra text remains optional
summary: Evia v129 restores the normal Evia evidence UI and repairs the 1:1 photo shutter.
changes: Moved photo and video capture into the existing Evia shell
Rebuilt photo capture around a ready camera frame with a reliable square crop
Added camera fallback instead of a dead shutter
Kept staged evidence, required photo explanations and guided video timestamps
Removed the detached v127 capture layer and old recorder assets
Moved Evia's offline cache to v129
